## About this build

The new renderer is experimental, so you may run into problems with it. I won't be continuing work on this port, so issues reported from here on may not get a fix. Thank you to everyone who tested, reported problems and helped along the way.

The source is open (GPL). You're very welcome to fork it, make your own changes and work on any issues that come up.

All previous releases stay on the releases page as they are. If you'd rather play a version without the new renderer, or this build gives you trouble, v1.5.2 and the earlier releases are still there.
